describe: The image shows a pale beige-pink field carrying several separate flat graphic elements. At the top left is an olive-yellow bar and a thin olive curved stroke at the top right. Beneath them are a thin black-and-white arc with a faint blurred grey fan of rays, a solid dark brick-red rectangle at the lower left, and a cream panel with an olive line at the lower right. The centre right has an olive line-drawing of tulip-like flowers. Fully opaque, no transparent areas.
